claim: Les 3 Vallées is the world's largest interconnected ski area with 347 marked trails over 600 km served by 155 lifts, directly accessible from Courchevel.
quote: Les 3 Vallées and its 600 kilometers of slopes, making it the largest ski area in the world
extra: 347 trails, 155 lifts per skiresort.info and 3 Vallées official

claim: From Courchevel, beginners can ski safely on gentle slopes while experts can tackle the Grand Couloir, an ungroomed but avalanche-controlled run.
quote: legendary spots such as the Grand Couloir, an ungroomed but avalanche-controlled run that guarantees an unforgettable descent

claim: The Courchevel Valley lift pass (local area) costs €74.80/day adult and €374 for 6 days in high season (Dec 20-Apr 10), with under-5s and over-75s free.
quote: 1 day: Adult €74.80 | Child €61.30 ... 6 days: Adult €374 | Child €306.60 ... Children under 5 and persons over 75 receive free access

claim: The full 3 Vallées pass covering 600 km costs €81.80/day adult (6 days €409) and €67/day for children aged 5-18 in high season.
quote: 1 Day: €81.80 ... 6 Days: €409 ... Child Pricing (Ages 5-18, High Season) 1 Day: €67 6 Days: €335

claim: Courchevel's own valley has 150 km of pistes broken down as 11 green, 14 blue, 15 red and 6 black runs, with over half the terrain green or blue.
quote: Courchevel 1850 has 11 green, 14 blue, 15 red and 6 black pistes ... more than half of the slopes are green or blue

claim: ESF Courchevel 1850 private lessons in high season 2025-2026 run from €430 for a 3-hour morning to €700 for a full day and €800 for the premium 9am-5pm formula.
quote: High Season Rates ... Premium Formula (9am-5pm): €800; Day package (9:30am-4:30pm): €700 ... 3-hour morning (9am-12pm): €430

claim: Courchevel has dedicated beginner zones such as Easy Rider, plus a Family Park on the Verdons piste with airbags, rails, kickers, boardercross and a Western Park for children.
quote: Easy Rider in Courchevel allow beginners to learn in complete safety ... Family Park located on the Verdons piste ... big air bags, rails, kickers, boxes, and boardercross

claim: Courchevel Aventure offers 1-hour evening snowmobile (motoneige) rides above the altiport, 1-2 people per machine, at €350 private or €200 group per snowmobile, passengers from age 8 and drivers needing a valid license.
quote: 1 hour of snowmobiling... 1 to 2 people per snowmobile... Private Ride: €350 / SNOWMOBILE... Group Ride: €200 / SNOWMOBILE... The passenger must be at least 8 years old

claim: Snowmobiling in Courchevel runs on a secure 700-metre circuit and as night rides through spruce forests after the ski area closes, operated by Courchevel Aventure based at Courchevel 1850.
quote: A secure 700-meter circuit for children and adults... Night rides when the ski area closes, in the calm of snow-covered nature, between spruce forests, enchanting clearings and gentle slopes

claim: The Moriond Racing toboggan run is 3 km with 450 m vertical drop, costs €17 per run (with a €160 deposit), and is open 13 January to 2 April 2026; under 1.10 m not permitted.
quote: 3km of pure adrenalin... 450m of vertical drop... 17€ /run... 160€ deposit... from 13 January to 2 April 2026... Children under 1.10m are not permitted

claim: Beyond Moriond Racing, Courchevel offers a 2 km toboggan run from Courchevel 1850 down through fir trees to Courchevel Village, plus dedicated children's sledding areas at 1850 and La Tania.
quote: 2 km course through snow-covered fir trees to Courchevel Village... Dedicated areas for children are available at Courchevel 1850 and Courchevel La Tania

claim: Dog sledding (chiens de traineaux) in Courchevel is offered by Raquette Evasion, musher Christophe Sujdovic and Courchevel Aventure, with daytime rides at Plan du Vah (approx 25 min) and evening rides at Plantret (around 45 min).
quote: Raquette Evasion... Christophe Sujdovic... Courchevel Aventure... Daytime at Plan du Vah - approx. 25 minutes... Evening at Plantret - around 45 minutes

claim: Smiles Parapente offers winter tandem flights over Courchevel from the Pas du Lac 2 cable car: Sensation/Horizon at €140 (10-20 min) and Premium at €180 (20-30 min), taking off on skis or snowboard.
quote: Horizon €140 15-20 min... Sensation €140 10-15 min... Premium €180 20-30 min... Cable car Pas du Lac 2 in Courchevel and Méribel

claim: Ice karting (karting sur glace) at the Courchevel 1850 ice rink runs 7-minute sessions for max 6 people, minimum age 8 and height 1m40, available 14/12/2025 to 06/04/2026 on Wednesdays between 7pm and 9pm.
quote: Minimum age 8 years, minimum height 1m40... Session duration: 7 minutes... Maximum 6 people per session... from 14/12/2025 to 06/04/2026 on Wednesday between 7 pm and 9 pm

claim: Courchevel's sledding-and-gliding lineup also includes airboarding (an inflatable sled ridden headfirst) and snakegliss (a single-file group sledding train).
quote: Airboarding - an inflatable sled that propels you headfirst for a rush of adrenaline... Snakegliss - a group sledding experience in a single file

claim: Courchevel's official winter activity menu includes snowshoeing (raquettes) off the beaten path and night-time sledding/tobogganing alongside paragliding and dog sledding.
quote: venture off the beaten path with snowshoeing... enjoy night-time sledding... soar over the peaks on a paragliding adventure... experience the life of a musher on a dog sledding expedition

claim: Courchevel summer lifts run only 4 July to 30 August 2026; winter closed 19 April 2026, so no lifts operate in May or June 2026.
quote: Courchevel area | July 4 | August 30 ... there are no lifts operating in May and June 2026.

claim: Three Courchevel lifts (Saulire cable car, Verdons gondola, Praz gondola) run daily from 4 July to 28 August 2026 for summer.
quote: from 4th July to 28th August 2026 ... Saulire cable car: 9:30am - 4:30pm; Verdons gondola: 9:30am - 4:40pm; Praz gondola: 9:30am - 4:45pm

claim: Courchevel's golf course is a 9-hole course at 1,900-2,000m on the Verdons plateau, playable to index 26.5, with driving range and weekend competitions.
quote: Holes: 9 holes; Altitude: 1,900 meters; Length: Over 1,200 meters ... open to all players and can be played up to an index of 26.5

claim: The 18-hole golf course is in neighbouring Meribel (par 71, 1,700m, in Vanoise National Park); Courchevel's own course is 9 holes; both open mid-June to October.
quote: Meribel Golf Course features an 18-hole layout with a par of 71, situated at 1,700 meters altitude ... Operating Season: Mid-June to end of October

claim: Courchevel offers mountain biking with green-to-black graded routes and the Col de la Loze climb (a Tour de France stage), with summer operations from 4 July.
quote: varied routes ranging from green to black levels ... relive a stage of the Tour de France ... Courchevel awaits you this summer from July 4th

claim: The Lac de la Rosiere via ferrata is a beginner-friendly ~600m route in two sections with a 65m footbridge and monkey bridge, averaging 2 hours.
quote: a 65-meter-long footbridge and has an average duration of 2 hours ... approximately 600-meter-long via ferrata is divided into 2 sections ... continues with a monkey bridge and a long ascending traverse

claim: Croix des Verdons is billed as the highest via ferrata in France (over 2,700m); Courchevel has multiple beginner routes (Lac de la Rosiere, Nant de Rossane, Le Diable), best in spring/summer/autumn.
quote: Croix des Verdons - described as 'the highest via ferrata in France' ... recommends 'spring, summer or autumn' ... advising against winter

claim: Lac de la Rosiere (Courchevel Moriond, Les Avals valley) has walking trails, a beginner via ferrata, parking, picnic area and toilets, and is reachable on foot.
quote: Multiple walking paths departing from the lake ... A beginner-level via ferrata ... parking nearby; picnic area; toilets ... 'La Rosiere lake loop'

claim: Golf de La Rosiere (a separate resort, not Courchevel) opens daily 20 June to 6 September 2026.
quote: open daily from June 20th until September 06th, 2026

claim: Aquamotion is an aquatic and wellness centre with outdoor pools, an indoor wave/surf pool, slides, a wild river, relaxation pools, sauna, steam room, salt cave, spa with massages/body treatments, climbing wall and fitness area.
quote: Outdoor pools with mountain views; indoor wave/surf pool; slides and water games; wild river; relaxation pools; sauna; steam room; salt cave; spa with massages and body treatments; climbing wall; fitness area

claim: Aquamotion is billed as Europe's largest mountain water park, with themed zones for Aqualudic, Aquawellness, Spa & Treatments, Surf, Climbing and Fitness, plus indoor surfing on a wave with instructor-led sessions.
quote: Aquamotion is Europe's largest mountain water park, featuring pools, slides, a spa, and wellness activities for the whole family... There is indoor surfing with a wave, and surfing sessions supervised by an instructor.

claim: Aquamotion's aqualudic zone includes a 25m pool, a triple water slide and diving boards, while the wellness side has three saunas, a steam room, a salt flotation pool, jacuzzi and plunge pool.
quote: One 25-metre length pool; triple water slide; multiple diving boards; indoor and outdoor leisure pools; 3 saunas and steam room; salt pool (flotation pool); jacuzzi; plunge pool; nursing pool for babies/young children

claim: Courchevel 1850 concentrates over 40 prestigious boutiques along Rue de l'Eglise and Rue du Rocher, with Chanel, Louis Vuitton, Prada, Dior, Gucci, Burberry and Valentino, making it the epicentre of alpine luxury shopping.
quote: Chanel, Louis Vuitton, Prada, Dior, and the exclusive Rolex boutique at DOUX Joaillier sit side by side in this exceptional district where alpine architecture meets the refinement of major fashion capitals.

claim: Maison DOUX Joaillier offers Cartier, Bulgari, Chopard, Breguet and Omega plus a dedicated Rolex space, while luxury skiwear comes from Bogner (a new 250m2 boutique), Moncler and Fusalp.
quote: Bogner, a pioneer of luxury sportswear, occupies a new 250m boutique in the heart of Courchevel 1850... Moncler, Fusalp and Bogner are the leading names for skiers with an eye for elegance.

claim: Top Courchevel 1850 nightlife includes Les Caves (exclusive underground nightclub with world-class DJs), Le Grange (chic club), and hotel bars like Le Bar at palace Les Airelles and Le Chabichou's refined bar.
quote: Les Caves de Courchevel is the most exclusive nightclub in Courchevel 1850... Le Grange epitomises Courchevel nightlife with chic and glitzy styling... Le Bar, located in the luxurious Palace Les Airelles hotel

claim: La Folie Douce is the legendary high-energy apres-ski with DJs and dancers, while Courchevel Moriond 1650 (e.g. Copina's Galician tapas and cocktails) is the unofficial nightlife capital and Courchevel 1850 is the glitziest, priciest village.
quote: La Folie Douce is legendary for apres ski, with DJs and dancers... Courchevel Moriond (1650) is now the unofficial hotspot for bars and clubbing... Courchevel 1850 is the glitziest and most expensive village

claim: Les Airelles spa offers La Mer and LBA treatment brands, an azure swimming pool, hammam, a jacuzzi heated to 40 degrees, fitness room and beauty salons.
quote: The spa features two exceptional brands: La Mer... and LBA - Laboratoires Botanique Avancee... The spa also has a hammam and a jacuzzi heated to 40 degrees.

claim: Le K2 Palace's 500 sqm Goji Spa has panoramic views, a heated pool, sauna, hammam, outdoor hot tub, five treatment rooms and Nescens Signature therapies plus a couples' double cabin.
quote: a 500 sqm space including a heated pool, sauna, hammam, and outdoor hot tub, alongside five treatment rooms. The spa specializes in rejuvenating skin treatments, including Nescens Signature therapies

claim: Cheval Blanc Spa features five treatment rooms plus an Orchidee couples' salon, bespoke Guerlain treatments and boutique, sauna, hammam, swimming pool, whirlpool and an outdoor Russian banya.
quote: 5 treatment rooms, one exclusive treatment room for two called the Orchidee Salon, Guerlain treatments designed uniquely for Cheval Blanc Courchevel... sauna, hammam, swimming pool, whirlpool and outdoor Russian banya

claim: Courchevel 1850 is the highest and most glamorous of the resort's levels, a billionaire/royalty playground served by the Courchevel Altiport at 2007m, one of Europe's highest airstrips, with a 537m runway requiring specially trained pilots.
quote: Courchevel 1850, the highest and most glamorous of the resort's interconnected levels, attracts royalty, industry leaders, and global tastemakers each season... Courchevel 1850 airfield is the highest airport in Europe

claim: Aquamotion is Europe's largest mountain aquatic centre and offers kids' spaces with a baby pool, slides, climbing and water games in a safe playful environment.
quote: fun spaces and activities for children: colorful baby pool, guided play sessions, slides, climbing, and water games... safe and playful

claim: Aquamotion runs a 'Kid's Adventure' afternoon with climbing, surf wave riding and pool games, plus an indoor surf wave available from age 7 and up.
quote: Kid's Adventure afternoon featuring climbing activities to build self-confidence, surf wave riding... indoor artificial wave for surfing or bodyboarding, available from age 7 and up

claim: The Family Park snowpark on the Verdons piste in Courchevel 1850 offers bumps, Big Air, rails, tables, a boarder cross and fun areas for older kids, plus a timed slalom.
quote: Family Park snowpark offers a series of bumps, Big Air, rails, tables, boarder cross and fun areas... timed slalom course where they can test their speed

claim: Courchevel Moriond has the Indian-themed Canyon de Yepa blue run (animals to spot, photo ops) accessed via the Ariondaz cable car, plus the beginner Western Skipark with cowboy theme and dedicated mats.
quote: Canyon de Yepa - Indian-themed blue run in Courchevel Moriond... Western Skipark - A beginner-friendly enclosed area near Moriond with gentle slopes and dedicated mats... cowboy atmosphere

claim: Courchevel offers two toboggan runs plus two dedicated children's sledging areas; the 3km Moriond Racing run descends to the slopes and a 2km floodlit run links Courchevel 1850 to Courchevel Village through the forest.
quote: Moriond Racing Toboggan Run... 3 km... Sledge Slope... Between Courchevel 1850 and Courchevel Village... 2 km... Fully illuminated for night sledging... in the heart of the forest

claim: The Courchevel 1850-to-Village sledging run is 2 km with 300 m of vertical and an average 15% incline, floodlit start to finish for evening descents.
quote: 2 km sledging run with 300 m of vertical and an average incline of 15%... floodlit from start to finish

claim: Toddlers can sled at the gentle Tovets area near Courchevel 1850, and the Perle de Lune Tepee & Kids Zone in the Western Ski Park (Moriond) offers face painting, archery, fancy dress and storytelling.
quote: Gentle sledging at Tovets Area near Courchevel 1850 for toddlers... Perle de Lune's Tepee & Kids Zone in Western Ski Park... face painting, archery, fancy dress, and playful storytelling

claim: Indoor and off-snow family options at Courchevel include an ice rink, climbing wall and bowling at the Forum, Le Tremplin cinema in 1850, husky rides and horse-drawn sleigh rides.
quote: Ice rink at the Forum... Climbing wall at the Forum... Bowling alley at the Forum... Le Tremplin Cinema (Courchevel 1850)... Husky rides... Horse-drawn sleighs

claim: Les Creux is a legendary wide, rolling blue run set in a forested basin between the Aiguille du Fruit and surrounding cols, a gentle playful gully suited to families.
quote: Les Creux blue run is described as a true legend in Courchevel, wide, rolling, and incredibly varied... mellows out into a beautiful and playful little gully

claim: Courchevel comprises four villages named historically for their elevations in metres: Le Praz (1300), 1550 (Village), 1650 (Moriond) and 1850, rebranded in 2011-2012 to drop the altitude numbers.
quote: Courchevel 1850 now known simply as Courchevel, Courchevel 1650 renamed Courchevel Moriond, Courchevel 1550 now called Courchevel Village, and Courchevel 1330 renamed Courchevel Le Praz.

claim: Courchevel 1850 is the highest and most exclusive village, the resort hub for luxury hotels, Michelin dining and designer boutiques, but crowded and expensive, making it the definitive luxury base.
quote: Courchevel (1850) remains the definitive choice for high-end visitors seeking opulent dining, shopping, and prestige—though expect crowds and substantial expenses.

claim: Courchevel Altiport sits at 2,008 m elevation with a 537 m runway at an 18.6% gradient, opened in 1961 as the first mountain airport of its kind, used by small fixed-wing aircraft like the Cessna 208 Caravan and Pilatus PC-12.
quote: 537 metres (1,762 ft) with a gradient of 18.6%... Elevation: 2,008 m / 6,588 ft... accommodates smaller fixed-wing planes like the Cessna 208 Caravan or Pilatus PC-12

claim: Chambéry is the closest airport (~100 km, ~1h30 transfer) but smaller; Geneva and Lyon are the nearest large international airports, with Geneva ~137 km / 2h15-3h and Lyon ~182 km / about 2h by motorway.
quote: Geneva and Lyon are the nearest large international airports to Courchevel, with the Geneva to Courchevel transfer covering approximately 137 km by road and taking between 2 hours 15 minutes and 3 hours

claim: Courchevel has no train station; TGV and Eurostar snow trains stop at Moûtiers ~25 km away, with a 35-60 minute transfer by road up to the resort, longer on Saturday changeover days.
quote: high speed (TGV) trains from Paris and the Eurostar snow train stop at Moûtiers, which is only 25km away. The 25km – 30 km journey from Moûtiers to Courchevel takes about 35 to 60 minutes door to door

claim: The Courchevel Pyrotechnic Art Festival, born in summer 2003 and extended to winter, runs roughly mid-February to early March with international companies competing; the 2025 edition ran February 13 to March 6 and was the 22nd edition.
quote: The Courchevel Pyrotechnic Festival was born in the summer of 2003... The 2025 edition ran from February 13 to March 6

claim: Courchevel hosts FIS Alpine Ski World Cup races: a women's night slalom on December 16 at the Émile-Allais Stadium and men's downhill on March 14-15 2026 on the L'Éclipse slope, during the resort's 80th anniversary season.
quote: December 16: FIS Alpine Ski World Cup (Women's Slalom) with a night slalom at the Émile-Allais Stadium... March 14–15: Men's Alpine Ski World Cup with Men's Downhill on the L'Éclipse slope
